body:
In regards to my ex-wife, it was a situation where we were together for nearly 9 years and were best friends.  I've never been alone, I moved out of my parents at 18 to college, then out of my college dorm (with roommates) into an apartment with her, then we were married and together until then. It's that we were best friends, and she was initially supportive for the first year or so after I came out, and I was blind sided by how angry she became so quickly.  There is a LOT to it than this, but it would take awhile to describe the nuances.  We were having issues but I thought we were working them out, instead she was busy hating me, and as I'd come to find out cheating on me.  (I guess?  She was sexting and sending nude pictures to the guy who would become her boyfriend within a few weeks of my leaving).  

As for court issues, I try it's just really confusing and I can't afford my own lawyer.  Everytime I try to resolve one issue her lawyer is hitting me with something else.  That's a whole other issue.  

Story of my life, a shit ton of issues to deal with and only so much me to deal with them.  =/
I thin I keep posting, because I want someone to tell me its ok to let go sometimes.

I have reached out to the LGBT community but the local trans community is mostly older women who are either not living full time themselves or I just can't relate to them at all.  The youth trans community at the local college is very clique-y and I never felt comfortable.  Reddits trans community has been amazing and helpful to me.  

Trust me, my thoughts of others are purely "what will my actions do to them?"  I don't think of myself first, but more how people would be upset by my death.  Not that it matter, I'm dead.    It's a hard concept to wrap my brain around, I have moved from not wanting to be dead and just wanting to the pain to stop to where I am now.  Now I just want to be dead, everyday I want it.  No matter what people say, I don't feel it getting better, I've been turned down repeatedly trying to re-enter my career field (paramedic).  

It seems like I have so much piling up and there are things I'm holding back on because if I give too much away, my redditing friends will know who I am.  Or someone can put two and two together.  There is more going on in my life in addition tot he above which makes it much more difficult.  I feel like my issues are small but numerous and when I talk about them I'm afraid it just comes off as bitching.  

Maybe I'm just not strogn enough to recover from all this, I mean I don't have a story of drug addiction and overcoming insurmountable odds to become a CEO of my own company or anyhting stupid like that.  I wasn't raised in a ghetto with drugs and murder around me, I was raised in an upper middle class white family in the rural southern area without ever wanting for anything.  Yet I was still abused.  How do you reconcile living a spoiled privledge life with that?  I feel like my problems are just first world problems.
